description: SQL data quality check: column and table checks on a CSV via DuckDB.

source_csv.description: Path to the CSV file relative to the project root
source_csv.title: Source Csv

not_null_columns.description: Column names to check for non-null values
not_null_columns.title: Not Null Columns

unique_columns.description: Column names to check for uniqueness
unique_columns.title: Unique Columns

table_checks.description: List of SQL expressions that must evaluate to true (e.g. 'COUNT(*) >= 100')
table_checks.title: Table Checks

min_rows.description: Optional minimum row count: adds COUNT(*) >= min_rows to the table checks (e.g. expect a full year of order lines)
min_rows.title: Min Rows

title: SQL data quality check
